svg.title: Order saga in Step Functions
svg.text: The order saga: one Standard workflow per order
Execution name = orderId, so a duplicate OrderPlaced event cannot start a second saga. Green = happy path, red = compensation, blue = forward recovery after the pivot.
Compensation (before the pivot): undo in reverse order
The parcel is already on a truck. Undoing the
payment would give the goods away, so the saga
stops compensating here and alerts a person.
Every Task has Retry (with backoff and JitterStrategy FULL) and Catch. Every external call carries an idempotency key built from orderId + step, so a retried step is safe.

Compensations are idempotent too: releasing stock twice must not add stock twice (use a reservation item per order, deleted with a condition). Failed executions can be redriven from the failed state after a fix.
